column1: # Playwright test moves (phase P1b onwards), read by scripts/android/playwright_inventory.py --diff.
# A rewritten Vue test keeps its place in the inventory when its rename is declared here.
# One rule per line: <old title><TAB><new title>
# Both titles are normalised inventory lines as they appear in playwright_list.txt:
#   <name>.spec.ts <U+203A> <describe part> <U+203A> <title>
# (no project prefix, no line:column; the separator is the character U+203A with one space on each side).
# A rule is stale, and fails the diff, when
#   - its old title is still present in the current list,
#   - its new title is absent from the current list,
#   - its old title is not in the baseline (docs/android/baseline/playwright_list.txt),
# and two rules with the same old title fail too.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The baseline itself is never edited.
# No rule yet.
